user.title: Analog Meter Reader
user.description: Provide EXACTLY ONE image source: a camera snapshot URL, or an existing HA camera entity (RTSP/ONVIF/Frigate/go2rtc/WebRTC - anything HA can already turn into a frame). The next step shows a live preview of that image so you can calibrate the crop box.

crop.title: Crop box calibration
crop.description:
{image_preview}

The image has a coordinate grid overlaid every 50px (orange) - read the digit strip's corner pixels off it. Enter them below and save: you'll see the box highlighted in red on the full image plus a separate crop preview, enlarged the way the AI sees it. Adjust the coordinates until the digits are readable - only then check "Confirm".

error.cannot_connect: Could not fetch an image from the given source.
error.choose_one_source: Provide exactly one image source - either the snapshot URL or the camera entity, not both and not neither.
error.invalid_crop: The crop box is empty or extends beyond the image bounds - fix the coordinates.

calibration_drift.title: Possible meter reading calibration issue
calibration_drift.description: The last {count} readings in a row were rejected or the AI was unsure of them. This usually means the camera moved, lighting changed, or the crop box no longer lines up with the digit strip. Check the image on this integration's `camera` entity - if the digits are no longer in frame, remove and re-add the integration to recalibrate the crop box.
